description: Stores phrases that are explicitly excluded from matching for a given entity type.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: entity_type_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX Entity Type to which this exclusion applies.

schema.name: display_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name of the entity type at the time of data extraction.

schema.name: excluded_phrase
schema.description: A specific phrase that should not be matched as part of this entity type.
